ratingNote: Owner-reported from App Store Connect on 2026-08-12 (was 21, set 2026-08-09). NOT machine-verified: the agent sandbox reaches the network through a proxy that refuses CONNECT to itunes.apple.com, so the usual re-check could not be run. Verify with: curl -s "https://itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=6758438948&country=jp" | grep -o '"userRatingCount":[0-9]*' — then edit ratingValue/ratingCount here and run node scripts/sync_constants.js --write. Since 2026-08-12 that propagates the JSON-LD aggregateRating on the 12 #app nodes too, which nothing enforced before.
appVersionNote: PUBLIC App Store version, confirmed live in App Store Connect on 2026-08-09. Keep this as the RELEASED version, not simplememo-ios/project.pbxproj's MARKETING_VERSION: release.yml ships tag -> Xcode Cloud -> TestFlight and App Review submission is a separate opt-in step (submit_review defaults to false), so the two can legitimately diverge. Re-check with: curl -s 'https://itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=6758438948&country=jp' | grep -o '"version":"[^"]*"' — then edit this one field and run: node scripts/sync_constants.js --write to propagate to 12 JSON-LD blocks and llms.txt.

priceNote: Confirmed unchanged by the owner on 2026-08-22. Values were set 2026-06-11 (PR #342) and have not been changed since — the owner states the prices are still current. **Still not machine-verified against App Store Connect**: IAP prices are not returned by the iTunes Lookup API, and the ASC API needs credentials this sandbox does not have. Prices appear on the site (pricing sections and JSON-LD offers), so a stale value would be a consumer-protection risk, not just a docs bug: Apple periodically adjusts JPY price tiers for FX. If that ever happens, update these four fields and this note's date, then run node scripts/sync_constants.js --write. Checked by scripts/check-store-facts.mjs (180-day window; longer than ratings because prices rarely change, but not unbounded).
